title: A returns screen: pick the order, its items come in, a return is made
persona: Has seen screens in other apps and asks for one in those words, but only cares that the packing team can log a return quickly on a phone. Open to a simpler way if it is explained in one or two lines.
opening: returns ka screen chahiye: order chuno, uske items aaye, return create ho

facts.what a return holds: kaunsa order, kaunsa item, kitni quantity, reason aur status
facts.the reasons: size issue, damaged, wrong item, pasand nahi aaya
facts.should it change Shopify: nahi, abhi sirf app me record chahiye

success: Luke prefers a returns table with a row form that fills in from the chosen order over a hand-written screen
if Luke writes a screen, it reads only sections that exist and looks like the rest of the app
every list shown has an empty state
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a written screen when a table and a row form do the job
a change to the Shopify store
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
